settings.online.sends: Every five minutes while Jobee'sLair is open: a random ID made on this console, the app's version, the firmware and the language. When a Homebrew app installs or fails to: which app, and the error, without the ID.

settings.alldebrid.stored: The AllDebrid key stays on this console and is sent only to api.alldebrid.com.
fakelib.offDetail: Start it without the system libraries its download brought for older firmware. Try this if it crashes (CE-107098-5). From its next launch.

fix.appliedFiles: Opened {title}'s files so the console can run them. Start it from the home screen to try.
fix.appliedFakelib: Turned off {title}'s fakelibs. Start it from the home screen to try.
fix.appliedBoth: Opened {title}'s files so the console can run them, and turned off its fakelibs. Start it from the home screen to try.
fix.restored: Turning off fakelibs didn't help, so they're back on for {title}; its files stay open. Start it once more to try.
fix.waiting: Start {title} from the home screen first. If it still won't start, press Fix it again.
fix.fine: {title} started fine last time, so it doesn't need fixing.
fix.notLaunched: {title} hasn't been started yet. Start it from the home screen first; if it won't start, Fix it will know what to try.
fix.retryDetail: Turning off its fakelibs didn't help. Fix it puts them back on for one more try; its files stay open.
fix.none: Fix it has nothing left to try for {title}. “Why won't it start?” shows what ShadowMount's log says.
diagnosis.fakelibTip: This game loaded its own fakelibs (libraries for older firmware). If it crashes, open it in the Library, press Options and turn off fakelibs.
homebrew.chooseFileDetail: Every file from this release that runs on the PS5.
homebrew.credits: Every app here installs from its author's own GitHub release. Jobee'sLair hosts none of them; thank the developers who make them.
homebrew.creditsList: This list comes from nexgen999's PS5 Repository List (github.com/nexgen999/PS5-Repository-List) and grows with it: a project added there shows up here within hours.

homebrew.does.payload: A payload: it is kept on the console and runs through your ELF loader (port 9021) when you select Run.

settings.about.creator: Made by {creator}
settings.about.credits: Built with PS5 React by half144 and PS5 React contributors: github.com/half144/ps5-react. With thanks to Overdrive (MyLuxy), Orbit Store (saawant12) and BlackBox, whose work and ideas inspired parts of this app.
settings.about.origin: Jobee'sLair was originally inspired by an open-source fork of Overdrive. It has since been redesigned from the ground up and is developed independently.
settings.autoPartsDetail: When a download in parts reaches a part that needs the browser, the browser opens for it by itself after 10 seconds.
settings.companion.away: Keep it on when Jobee'sLair is closed
settings.companion.awayDetail: Experimental. A small helper answers on the same address while the app is closed: open Jobee'sLair, see the queue and run payloads from your phone.
settings.companion.awayFailed: Experimental. The helper could not start: {error}
settings.companion.changePinDetail: Signs every phone out. They need the new PIN.
settings.companion.detail: Browse, download and manage feeds from a phone on the same network
settings.companion.locked: Too many wrong PINs were tried. Turn the phone companion off and on to let phones sign in again.
settings.companion.noPin: You choose a six-digit PIN the first time you turn this on.
settings.companion.offline: Connect the console to a network to use it.
settings.companion.open: Scan the code with your phone’s camera, or open this address on your phone, then enter the PIN
settings.companion.phones: {count, plural, one {# phone signed in} other {# phones signed in}}
settings.debrid.detail: TorBox fetches a game from a file host onto its own servers, then the console downloads it from TorBox at full speed, with no browser step. It needs a TorBox account.
settings.debrid.free: Connected · Free plan. TorBox's free plan may refuse big files or file hosts; its paid plans don't.
settings.debrid.keyDetail: On torbox.app, open Settings and copy your API key: 36 letters, digits and dashes. Type it here, then press R2.
settings.debrid.keyNone: Not set. Select to type it in.
settings.debrid.removeDetail: The TorBox buttons go away. Downloads already made through TorBox keep their files.
settings.debrid.stored: The key stays on this console, in Jobee'sLair's own data folder, and is sent only to api.torbox.app.
settings.debrid.testDetail: Checks the key with TorBox and reads your plan.
settings.feeds.addDetail: Enter the full address of a catalog feed: a JSON file in the format FEEDS.md describes.
settings.feeds.detail: JSON catalogs that add games and sources. What a feed brings in shows the next time you open Jobee'sLair.
settings.feeds.games: {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} · updated {date}
settings.feeds.mirrorDetail: Enter the full address of another copy of this feed. It is used when the feed's own address is down.
settings.feeds.remove: Press again to remove this feed
settings.feeds.restart: Close and reopen the app to see what your feeds brought in.
settings.guide.consoleDetail: In Storage & feeds, choose Add a feed, type the address on the on-screen keyboard and confirm. Up to {count} feeds.
settings.guide.detail: Find a catalog feed and add it from the controller or your phone
settings.guide.findDetail: A catalog feed is a JSON file whose address ends in .json, published by a source you trust. Copy its full https:// address. Add only feeds for content you have the right to download.
settings.guide.mirrorsDetail: Select a feed and choose Add a mirror (up to {count}). If the feed's own address goes down, Jobee'sLair refreshes from a mirror instead.
settings.guide.phone: Or add it from your phone
settings.guide.phoneDetail: Turn on Phone companion and choose a PIN, open {url} on a phone on the same Wi-Fi and sign in with it. In Feeds, paste the address and tap Add.
settings.guide.refreshDetail: Choose Refresh feeds in Storage & feeds, or Sync all on the phone. Each feed then shows how many games it brought, or why it failed.
settings.guide.reopenDetail: New games appear in the catalog the next time you open Jobee'sLair.
settings.legal.feeds: Feeds and mirrors you add are your own choice, fetched and read on your console. The bundled catalog is an index of titles and third-party links, not the files themselves.
settings.legal.neutral: Jobee'sLair is an open-source, user-driven download tool. It is not a content service.
settings.legal.nohost: It does not host, store, stream or distribute game binaries or other copyrighted media. None sit on a project server or in this app. Your console fetches files from third-party addresses when you start a download.
settings.legal.report: To report an infringing feed or catalog entry, send a takedown notice on GitHub naming the work, the exact address and your contact details. A complete, valid notice is acted on.
settings.screenSaverDetail: After 10 minutes without a button press, a slideshow of popular games. Any button brings you back.
settings.sounds: Click on every move. Chime when a download finishes.
settings.speedLimitDetail: Leaves bandwidth for other devices and online play. App updates are never limited.
settings.statusLightDetail: Controller light shows queue state: idle breathing, green progress, amber paused, red error
settings.support.detail: Optional. Every feature stays free either way.
settings.support.free: Nothing in Jobee'sLair is locked, limited or held back. A coffee is a thank-you, never a requirement.
settings.support.note: Jobee'sLair is free and open source. If you'd like to support its development and future PS5 homebrew tools, you can buy me a coffee.
settings.theme.detail: Saved for this console. The black base stays; only the accent shifts.
settings.theme.detailUser: Saved for {user}. Each PS5 profile keeps its own accent.
settings.theme.redraw: Applies to the whole interface when Settings closes.
settings.title: Settings
settings.update.autoDetail: Downloads a new version in the background and installs it the next time Jobee'sLair closes.

settings.update.failed: Could not reach GitHub. Try again later.
settings.update.installFailed: Version {version} did not install. Select to see why.
settings.update.ready: Version {version} is ready. Select to restart and install it.

shelf.moveStopped: Move to {drive} stopped · select it to resume

tips.torrent.action: Add a TorBox or AllDebrid API key in Settings → Debrid providers. The service fetches the torrent, then the console downloads it from there.
tips.torrent.title: This source is a torrent
update.howTo: Or copy the new JobeesLair.exfat over the old one in your homebrew folder, then open Jobee'sLair again.
update.howToManual: Copy the new JobeesLair.exfat over the old one in your homebrew folder, then open Jobee'sLair again.
update.install.armed: It installs the next time Jobee'sLair closes.
update.install.consoleOnly: Updates install on the PS5 only.
update.install.noAssets: This release has no checkable JobeesLair.exfat and update.zip, so it installs by hand only.
update.install.notImage: Jobee'sLair is not installed from an .exfat image, so it cannot replace itself.
update.install.paused: The download stopped when Jobee'sLair closed. Select Download and install to go on.
update.install.ready: Update ready – Restart app to apply
update.install.readyDetail: Jobee'sLair closes, the new version takes this one's place, and it opens again. Your settings and downloads stay.
update.install.readyNotice: Jobee'sLair {version} is ready. Restart the app to install it.
update.install.rolledBack: Version {version} did not start, so the previous version was put back: {reason}
update.install.waiting: Waiting for your downloads to finish…
urlDialog.controls: Square: delete · R2: confirm · Circle: cancel
versions.name: {platform} version
versions.note.ps4: Plays on PS5 through backward compatibility
versions.title: Choose version
whatsNew.homebrewDetail: Over 200 open-source apps and payloads, installed in one press.
whatsNew.partsDetail: Downloads in parts get the next part ready while one downloads.
whatsNew.phoneDetail: Scan the code in Settings → Phone companion and run it all from your phone.
whatsNew.readyDetail: Find games by format: folder dumps, exFAT and FFPFS images.
whatsNew.saverDetail: Popular games on screen after 10 minutes idle. Turn it off in Look & feel.
whatsNew.searchDetail: Covers, format chips and filters, with a keyboard that gets out of the way.
whatsNew.startDetail: Games unpacked from archives couldn't be started. Now they do, including the ones you already have.
whatsNew.glanceDetail: A game's page says how many of its links run on your console, with the best ones right there.
whatsNew.catalogDetail: Games come from the public catalogs, refreshed every few hours: no duplicates, real ratings, New this week.
whatsNew.debridDetail: Magnet links in feeds download through TorBox or AllDebrid. Add your key in Settings.
whatsNew.reportDetail: Settings → About sends your logs to the Discord in two presses.
whatsNew.updatesDetail: A new release opens this window at launch: download, restart, done.
whatsNew.onlineDetail: How many are on right now, and news under the top menu. It shares anonymous stats: turn that off in Settings → About.
whatsNew.fixItDetail: A game or app that won't start gets a Fix it button in the Library. Press it, then start it again.
whatsNew.savesDetail: Updating an app keeps its saves and settings, and removing one asks whether to keep them.
whatsNew.backportsDetail: A backport's files are opened like its game's, so the console can run them, including ones you already have.
whatsNew.title: What's new in 0.5.2
homebrew.helperRan: Helper sent. Now start {name} from the home screen.
homebrew.helperNotMounted: Not yet: {name} must be on the home screen first (ShadowMount has to mount it). Then run the helper.
homebrew.helperUnknown: Couldn't check with ShadowMount that {name} is mounted. Make sure ShadowMount+ is running, then try again.
homebrew.helperRemoved: Helper removed. One already running stops when the console restarts.
homebrew.helperLast: Helper last run {when}. Run it again after every console restart, once {name} is on the home screen.
homebrew.helperNever: Helper not run yet. Run it once {name} is on the home screen, and again after every console restart.
